title: Hun residents' protest and civil disobedience after civilian killing
notes: Al Jazeera dates the physical protest at a Haftar-affiliated military facility to Thu Dec31, despite its Jan1 publication. Reports say residents demanded justice and removal of foreign fighters; no crowd size is reported. A Jan6 Libya Al-Ahrar report says civil disobedience lasted four consecutive days and ended after a meeting with a Haftar-affiliated military delegation, whose promises had not been fulfilled at publication. The exact civil-disobedience dates are not reported. Do not code this factional meeting as official state accommodation; no separate January public gathering is confirmed.

title: Pensioners' syndicates protest outside GNA headquarters in Tripoli (February boundary lead)
notes: LANA reports a Feb1 public protest outside the GNA headquarters by pensioner syndicates from multiple cities. The reported demands concern pension arrears, insurance and a pension increase. No count is stated, and no January start or prior continuation is evidenced; treat as a February lead, not a January event.
